bio: As of July 2025, it has been possible to enjoy La Scarpetta's truly delicious and authentic Italian food in Zurich as well as in St Moritz. The appealing à la carte selection includes dishes such as carpaccio di gambero rosso and ossobucco & risotto allo zafferano. There is also a tempting lunch menu. The cosy interior sports beautiful wood panelling. In one of the two separate dining areas, there are also a few spots at the bar, on which an impressive espresso machine and a large wine cooler catch the eye. A pleasingly lively atmosphere reigns, and the service is friendly and relaxed. There is an excellent, high-calibre wine list. The small terrace is inviting in summer....
